headline: Cement duo both profitable in first half of 115, all thanks to diversification; cross-strait cement still sluggish - Finance
summary: Taiwan Cement and Asia Cement reported combined first-half after-tax profit of NT$7.114 billion, with Taiwan Cement's profit up 241% year on year. Cross-strait cement demand remained sluggish.
why: Taiwan Cement and Asia Cement are Taiwan's largest cement producers, and their results reflect construction demand and diversification into other businesses.
